svg.aria-label: Status infographic for the Lean 4 Wikidata port
svg.text: An executable ontology engine for Wikidata, with every guarantee machine-checked — ported from the upstream Agda bridge.
Where the work sits — a 3D skyline of the development
one tower per area; height = theorems, footprint = modules, glowing cap = negative results (“this inference is not licensed”)
Polarity and view joins on Wikidata
60 Wikidata-facing surfaces of the Agda bridge, classified
OWL beyond the class and property
Of the bridge's 11 stated invariants, 9 are re-proved here as theorems and
2 dissolve on porting (one kernel, real checkers); 0 are left open.
the Wikidata import against everything else
The ontology engine is the larger half: 58% of the lines and 79%
of the proofs that the machine closes by computation.
tilted ring gauges — each one is a share of the whole
Growth, pass by pass — a 3D area chart
two extruded ribbons: theorems in front, lines of Lean behind; both cumulative over the five passes of the port
three things a supporter can check for themselves
The ontology is executable: 202 theorems are closed
by running the checker, and each engine comes with
an exactness theorem saying the computation agrees
218 of the 932 theorems say some inference is “not
licensed” — an absence is not a refutation, a
diagnostic is not permission to edit, support does
No sorry, no added axioms, and only the standard
imported claims are fail-closed and must be backed
How it was built — five passes
each pass took what was genuinely new upstream and re-founded it on executable machinery
Belnap's four corners, so conflict and
Every figure here is counted from the Lean sources by tools/supporter_infographic.py; the classification of upstream surfaces is transcribed from PORTING_NOTES.md and RELATED_WORK.md.
Read more: docs/status/STATUS_REPORT.md · PORTING_NOTES.md · RELATED_WORK.md · machine-readable numbers in docs/status/status.json
lake build: clean · 0 sorry · no added axioms · axioms used: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound
